# @nestarc/tenancy

> NestJS tenant context and Prisma integration for PostgreSQL Row Level Security.

Documented version: 0.16.2. Verify the consumer application's installed version; published 0.16.1 does not contain the current security changes.

## Start here

- [Package README](./README.md)
- [Consumer integration guide](https://nestarc.dev/packages/tenancy/agent-guide)
- [Runnable quickstart](./examples/quickstart/README.md)
- [Security upgrade and deployment sequence](https://nestarc.dev/packages/tenancy/migration#upgrade-to-0-16-2)
- [Official documentation](https://nestarc.dev/packages/tenancy/)
- [Published API reference](https://nestarc.dev/api/tenancy/)

## Essential boundaries

- Authenticate before tenant extraction and authorize the principal for the selected tenant.
- Apply RLS policies and use an application DB role without superuser/BYPASSRLS privileges.
- Shared models and explicit no-context helpers skip client behavior, not database RLS.
- Use the transaction helper for raw SQL and interactive transactions.
- RPC validators are explicit during 0.x; caches and messages require their own tenant scope.

This is a convenience index for clients that choose to read it. It does not guarantee discovery, ranking, or citations. Repository maintainers can use AGENTS.md; application consumers should use the integration guide.
